shots.note: close push_in: His face fills the frame in dark forest smoke, eyes steady and lips in a cold half-smile on "killed", so the wish reads as a plan, not despair.
low_angle tilt_up: Kacha kneels with eyes closed while a paper fire burns high in front of his knees and smoke rolls past; the demon army waits in the haze.
insert crane_down: A grey ash pile sits on the dark forest floor while a horned demon looks down at it with a satisfied smirk; sparks still float.
low_angle tilt_up: Old Shukracharya, huge from below in the fire-lit demon hall, tips back a wine cup with ash swirling in it, eyes half closed in pleasure.
medium dolly_left: Kacha stands in the dark ashram yard holding up a glowing palm-leaf mantra and eyeing it with a scheming smile: the secret he came to steal.
wide crane_up: On the smoky battlefield Shukracharya raises his palm and a shaft of light falls on a slain demon, who rises from the ground with open arms.
close push_in: Kacha's face in the night yard with the glowing palm leaf under his chin; he smiles coldly, the light of the stolen mantra on his face.
close pull_out: Devayani in the dark ashram, tears on her face: her loving look breaks into pain on "loved"; a faint red curse-glow pulses behind her head.
wide dolly_right: On a smoky battlefield Indra hurls his thunderbolt and a demon topples backwards on "killed" while a demon army burns in the haze.
wide crane_up: Old Shukracharya at the edge of the battle lifts his palm; a beam of warm light falls on the fallen demon, who rises up with his arms open.
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya stands tall in the fire-lit feast hall, white beard and maroon robe, a horned silhouette army behind him; he raises his palm on "guru".
close push_in: Shukracharya's face, eyes closed, lips chanting; a golden yantra circle glows behind his head and the word Mritasanjivani appears.
wide pull_out: Indra backs away on the left, afraid, as rows and rows of demon silhouettes with ember eyes fill the battlefield to the horizon.
establishing crane_down: In the dim golden hall of heaven Brihaspati stands at the centre on the red runner and opens his hands; Agni, Vayu, Indra and Surya turn to him.
close push_in: Brihaspati's grey-bearded face in close-up, brows heavy and mouth turned down; the dim gold arches blur behind him.
medium dolly_left: Brihaspati, talking, raises one finger; Indra and Agni lean in to listen to the single word.
extreme_close static: Brihaspati's narrowed eyes in extreme close-up while the word Mritasanjivani burns above him and a yantra glows behind.
two_shot dolly_left: Indra in his tall crown opens his hands, shocked, asking; on "steal" his face turns to doubt while Brihaspati listens gravely.
medium pan_right: Far away in his dusky ashram Shukracharya holds the glowing palm-leaf mantra against his chest, brows hard and lips shut.
two_shot pull_out: Back in the council Brihaspati raises a calm palm toward Indra, who lowers his thunderbolt arm and listens.
medium push_in: Brihaspati smirks to the side while, behind him in the central arch, the dark silhouette of a young man fades in: the someone.
close dutch: Brihaspati in close-up, frame tilting, his mouth curls into a cold knowing smile.
establishing pan_right: At dusk a young man in a saffron shawl walks in from the left across the ashram yard toward old Shukracharya, who waits by his hut.
two_shot push_in: The young man drops to his knees before Shukracharya on "asked", hands folded; the old guru looks down at him with a soft smile.
medium dolly_right: Kneeling Kacha holds up his wrist while Shukracharya bends forward with both hands and ties a red-gold thread on it.
insert push_in: The red-gold raksha thread fills the frame on his wrist, its knot glowing; Kacha's face beside it looks down at it, calm.
two_shot pull_out: Shukracharya smiles warmly at his new student on the right, while Kacha on the left looks away with a sly, secret look.
medium dolly_left: Kacha stands and speaks with folded hands to the old guru; his name appears above him.
wide pan_left: In the lit doorway of the hut a young woman in a maroon sari leans and watches Kacha with soft eyes; Kacha, in front, does not see her.
two_shot push_in: Devayani steps out and speaks shyly to Kacha; her name appears above her as Kacha turns and smiles at her.
close crane_down: Devayani's face in close-up: she lowers her eyes and blushes into a small smile, the jasmine in her hair catching the dusk light.
two_shot dolly_right: Under the dusky sky Devayani gazes at Kacha with a loving smile; Kacha smiles back at her, the hut lamps glowing behind them.
wide pan_right: In warm morning light Kacha stands outside a mud wall singing with a hand on his chest; Devayani leans in the open window, listening with love.
two_shot push_in: At dusk Kacha holds out a bunch of red and white wild flowers; Devayani reaches out and takes them, smiling with joy.
wide dolly_left: In Kacha's lamp-lit room he sits on his reed mat; a near-black shadow figure with an ember outline slips in from the right toward him.
close push_in: The black head of the shadow fills the frame with a thin ember outline around grey jata and beard; his name appears above it.
two_shot pan_left: The shadow bends toward Kacha and points at him, asking; Kacha on his mat looks up at his father.
close push_in: Kacha's face in lamplight, answering softly with a sly look aside.
medium pull_out: At night Devayani leans in her lamp-lit window, chin tilted, gazing toward Kacha's room with a dreamy, loving smile.
wide crane_down: In the fire-lit demon hall two demons laugh over a fire, one holding a wine cup; Kacha stands in the left foreground watching them.
medium push_in: A spotted deer is laid down in the flames, darkening as the fire burns high around it; a horned demon watches, grinning.
insert crane_down: Big in frame, the golden wine cup swirls with grey ash while black flakes drop into it; the plum feaster demon peers at it from the right.
medium pull_out: Shukracharya tips back the ash-swirled cup with closed eyes while two demons beside him raise their arms and laugh.
close push_in: Kacha's face in close-up, eyes wide and fixed to the right where the ash-swirled wine cup glints out of focus.
extreme_close dutch: Extreme close-up of Kacha's eyes widening and then narrowing into a scheming smirk, a red pulse throbbing behind his head.
medium dolly_right: Kacha looks down at his own open palm as grey ash and sparks swirl up out of it, imagining his own body as ash.
medium pull_out: Alone in his lamp-lit room Kacha sits on the mat, fear on his face, then his jaw sets calm on "But".
low_angle tilt_up: A slate-green demon with a sword glares and points out of the frame, red-eyed, with the black silhouette army behind him.
medium push_in: Shukracharya lifts his wine cup in the feast hall and laughs with pleasure, eyes half shut.
wide dolly_left: At dusk Devayani stands between Kacha and her father, gazing lovingly at Kacha; on "father" she turns her loving eyes to Shukracharya.
close static: Devayani's face in the centre, Kacha's face on the left and her father's on the right in the dark, exactly balanced on both sides of her.
medium push_in: In his dark room Kacha sits cross-legged before three small oil lamps, scheming; the words Three stages appear above him.
medium dolly_left: Kacha stands in his room and raises his hand with a sly smile; the numerals I and II appear: the stages he controls.
medium crane_down: Devayani leans in her lamp-lit window at night, smiling, unaware; the numeral III appears beside her, and her name.
ots pull_out: Kacha's face fills the left foreground with a cold look while, behind him, Devayani smiles in her lamp-lit window, unaware.
establishing crane_down: The feast hall roars: three demons raise their cups and laugh by the fire bowls, the silhouette army sways behind; Stage one appears.
medium push_in: Kacha lifts a wine cup and sways with a loose laughing face, head tilted; a laughing demon beside him thinks he is one of them.
two_shot dolly_right: Kacha leans to the plum feaster demon and whispers with a sly face; the demon tilts his horned head to listen, eyes widening.
close push_in: The plum demon's face in close-up: eyes bulging and mouth open in shock as wine spits from his lips.
medium pan_right: The plum demon whispers into a green demon's ear, and the green demon turns, shocked, to tell the brute next to him.
low_angle tilt_up: The brute demon roars with claws out, eyes red, and the fire bowls behind flare up as the whole silhouette army turns angry.
high_angle crane_up: Kacha stands small in the centre, afraid, while rings of demon silhouettes with glowing red eyes close in all around him.
two_shot handheld: The green demon lunges with clawed hands at Kacha's throat; Kacha flinches back with fear.
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya raises his palm high and shouts with a furious face, his white beard lit by the fire; his name appears.
two_shot dolly_left: Shukracharya points at Kacha's raised wrist where the red sacred thread glows; Kacha holds it up, calm.
medium push_in: Shukracharya points his finger at the demons, who lower their heads; Kacha stands behind the guru, protected.
wide pull_out: The demons slink back toward the dark arches; Kacha is left alone in the firelight with a hidden cold smile.
wide handheld: In the lamp-lit room Devayani strides in from the left with furious red eyes and clenched face; Kacha stands by his bed, surprised.
two_shot push_in: Kacha holds his hands out gently and speaks softly; Devayani's furious face melts into calm.
medium pan_left: Devayani turns and walks out to the left with a soft smile; Kacha watches her go with a cold, satisfied look.
high_angle crane_up: From above, Kacha lies on his low bed in the dark room, eyes wide open, staring at the ceiling.
medium dolly_right: In the dim feast hall two demons whisper over a low fire with red eyes; the brute points out toward Kacha's room, murder on his face.
close push_in: Kacha's face in the lamplight, eyes open in the dark, lips curling into a cold smile.
wide pan_right: At dawn Kacha walks into the smoky forest leading two bay horses; the words Stage two appear.
medium push_in: Deep among black trunks and smoke Kacha halts and stands still, while the horses graze behind him.
medium static: Kacha stands motionless in the smoky dawn light, eyes half closed, breathing slowly.
wide dolly_left: Between the far tree trunks rows of red ember eyes glow in the smoke; Kacha stands small in the right foreground, facing them.
close push_in: Kacha's face in close-up in the dawn smoke: calm, and on "and" a small knowing smile.
wide pan_right: The grazing horse jerks its head up and Kacha turns toward the sound as horned silhouettes with red eyes loom out of the smoke.
medium crane_down: Kacha kneels on the forest floor beside a pile of branches; a fire flares up in front of him.
low_angle tilt_up: Huge black demon silhouettes stride in at both sides of the frame, close to the camera; small in the middle Kacha kneels at his fire.
wide handheld: Rows of horned demons with glowing eyes stand right behind kneeling Kacha, much closer now, their weapons raised.
close push_in: Kacha's face lit from below by the fire, eyes cast down to the ground, never lifting.
medium pull_out: Kacha kneels with hands on his knees by the fire, absolutely still, while demon silhouettes stand on both sides.
low_angle tilt_up: Two demons loom from below: the green one bares his claws and short sword, the brute lifts his mace, both with burning red eyes.
high_angle crane_up: From above, kneeling Kacha is a small lit figure inside a dense ring of horned silhouettes that blots out the dawn.
medium handheld: Close on kneeling Kacha: his body trembles and his face shows pain, then on "but" his face settles into calm.
extreme_close push_in: Extreme close-up of Kacha's face in firelight: the faint cold smile of a plan working.
low_angle dutch: Kacha kneels with his eyes closed as the demons behind him raise their weapons high over his head.
medium handheld: The green demon slashes down on "killed" and Kacha collapses; a red pulse flashes across the forest.
wide crane_up: A big fire burns in the clearing with demon silhouettes around it; beside it a grey pile of ash grows where the body was.
insert crane_down: The golden wine cup fills the frame, grey powder swirling in it while black flakes fall in; the plum demon watches with a sly grin.
two_shot dolly_right: The plum demon offers the wine cup with a cold smile; Shukracharya reaches for it, smiling, suspecting nothing.
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya tips the ash-swirled cup to his lips and drains it, eyes closed, beard lit by the fire.
medium push_in: Shukracharya rests a hand on his belly with a satisfied smile while a faint red glow pulses inside him.
wide dolly_left: In the black night forest Devayani stumbles out from between the trunks, bent with grief, a scrap of cloth in her hand.
insert push_in: A charred scrap of Kacha's saffron cloth fills the right of the frame, holes burnt through it; Devayani's tear-stained face looks at it.
two_shot pan_right: In the night ashram yard Devayani stands with the cloth before her father; Shukracharya turns to her, and his name appears.
medium push_in: Devayani holds the burnt cloth out to her father, tears running, her voice breaking.
two_shot dolly_left: Devayani points at her father in grief and anger; Shukracharya recoils in shock.
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya raises his fist-like palm high with a furious face, shouting vengeance in the firelit night yard.
medium static: Shukracharya freezes mid-gesture, his anger turning to puzzlement as he looks at his daughter.
close push_in: Devayani's face in close-up: she is laughing, mouth open, eyes wet.
extreme_close dutch: Extreme close-up of Devayani: tears stream down her cheeks while she laughs wildly.
two_shot pull_out: Laughing and crying, Devayani points at her father's belly; Shukracharya's face fills with horror.
close dolly_right: Devayani's face close on the left as she reaches toward her father; on the right a black speck of ash glints on his white beard by his lips.
insert push_in: The black ash flakes, huge in the centre, glow on Devayani's fingertip; her face on the left and her father's on the right stare at it.
medium pan_left: In a remembered flash of the feast hall, the plum demon grins and holds up the ash-swirled wine cup.
close push_in: Shukracharya's face, brows twisted in horror, eyes squeezing shut on "closed".
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya stands tall in the night yard and raises his hand to make a solemn declaration.
medium pull_out: Shukracharya flings the wine cup to the ground with a furious curse, a red curse-ring flaring round his raised hand.
close push_in: Shukracharya looks down in pain and shame; the memory of the red sacred thread he tied glows faintly beside him.
two_shot dolly_left: Devayani faces her father firmly, hands open, telling him; Shukracharya listens with a heavy face.
close crane_down: Shukracharya nods slowly in close-up, a gold yantra glowing behind him as the word Mritasanjivani appears.
medium push_in: Shukracharya lays a hand on his belly, where a small red-glowing figure of Kacha is curled up inside him.
two_shot dolly_right: Devayani stares in shock as a red pulse throbs in her father's belly, the place Kacha would have to tear open.
medium pull_out: Shukracharya folds his hands calmly and smiles at his daughter with love: he accepts.
close push_in: Devayani's face freezes in shock, eyes wide and mouth open.
medium dolly_left: Devayani in the foreground clutches the burnt cloth, pain on her face; behind her, out of focus, her father stands waiting.
close pull_out: Devayani's pained face in the centre; on the left Kacha's face glows red like a ghost, on the right her father's face waits in the dark.
medium push_in: Devayani begs with outstretched hands, crying, toward her father.
close static: Devayani's crying face in the centre with Kacha's face on the left and her father's on the right, exactly balanced.
low_angle tilt_up: Shukracharya stands over her with open hands like two pans of a scale, his face stern.
medium dolly_right: Devayani looks to the glowing burnt cloth of Kacha on the left, then to her father on the right, torn.
close push_in: Devayani's face lights up: eyes wide, a hopeful smile breaking through her tears.
two_shot dolly_left: Devayani holds out both hands to her father, pleading; Shukracharya hesitates.
two_shot pull_out: Devayani explains eagerly, gesturing with open hands; her father listens, doubtful.
wide crane_down: In memory, Shukracharya sits cross-legged in prayer before the dark peaks of Kailash, a golden yantra glowing behind him.
close push_in: Devayani's face pleads with soft wet eyes and raised brows.
close static: Shukracharya's face softens with love and he nods.
insert crane_down: Seated Shukracharya writes on a glowing palm leaf held in his hand, letters of light appearing on it.
two_shot dolly_right: Devayani holds the glowing palm leaf; her father raises one warning finger at her.
medium push_in: Devayani presses the glowing leaf to her chest and nods solemnly.
wide crane_down: Shukracharya sits cross-legged in the night yard, eyes closed, chanting; Devayani stands aside clutching the leaf, watching.
medium handheld: The seated guru's body shakes violently; dark-red paper blood bursts at his belly.
medium push_in: Blood splashes burst one after another at the guru's chest, face and arms as his body shakes and his face twists in pain.
close dutch: Close on Shukracharya's face twisted in pain, a dark-red burst of paper blood spraying from one eye.
medium pull_out: The seated guru's body starts to split open like a torn cocoon, blood spraying from his belly as a figure pushes out.
wide tilt_up: The guru's torn body lies on the ground in a pool of dark-red paper blood and Kacha rises straight up out of his chest, bloodied, arms opening; Devayani stares in horror.
two_shot dolly_left: Devayani throws her arms around blood-smeared Kacha, laughing and crying at once; behind them her father's torn body lies in a pool of blood.
close push_in: Devayani rests her head on Kacha's shoulder with closed eyes, weeping and smiling; above her, Kacha's eyes are cold and distant.
extreme_close dutch: Extreme close-up of Kacha's face smeared with blood: a cold, crooked smile with hard eyes.
two_shot pan_right: Devayani holds up the glowing palm leaf and turns to her father's body lying in blood; Kacha stands behind her.
two_shot push_in: Kacha holds out his open hand for the leaf with a gentle face; Devayani hesitates, doubtful.
medium dolly_left: Devayani turns away from Kacha, pulling the glowing leaf out of his reach; Kacha's eyes follow it.
close push_in: Devayani's face is firm and guarded as she speaks.
close crane_down: Kacha's face softens into a hurt, loving look as he asks.
two_shot push_in: Kacha and Devayani face each other close up; his voice is tender and her guarded face melts into love.
wide pan_right: Kacha gestures with an open hand toward the guru's body lying in blood; Devayani looks at her father with hope.
extreme_close static: Kacha's and Devayani's eyes lock in a very close double close-up, his steady, hers melting.
insert tilt_down: The glowing palm-leaf mantra tumbles down through the dark air out of Devayani's loosened hand.
medium push_in: Kacha snatches the glowing leaf out of the air with a sudden cold smile.
wide dolly_right: Kacha stands over the guru's bloody body and reads aloud from the glowing palm leaf; Devayani watches with hope.
low_angle tilt_up: In the feast hall a horned demon raises his mace proudly while the silhouette army behind him cheers.
wide crane_down: Before the dark peaks of Kailash Shiva stands with an open hand; golden rays fall around him and his name appears.
close push_in: Kacha's face lit gold from below by the glowing leaf, lips moving as he memorises the mantra.
medium tilt_up: Shukracharya, bloodstained, rises to his feet from the pool of blood, his face softening as he looks for his daughter.
two_shot dolly_left: Shukracharya steps toward Devayani with a loving face and opening hands; she smiles back with joy.
ots pan_left: Kacha in the foreground holds up the glowing mantra; behind him Shukracharya's face freezes in shock as he sees it.
close push_in: Kacha's face: a calm, cold smile of victory.
close static: Shukracharya's face in close-up: no anger at all, only deep pain, tears in his old eyes.
medium crane_down: Shukracharya topples backwards to the ground, arms flung out; Devayani reaches toward him in shock.
wide pan_right: Kacha turns his back and walks away to the right with the glowing leaf; behind him the guru lies on the ground and Devayani kneels by him.
medium dolly_right: Devayani runs after Kacha with her sari flying; Kacha keeps walking away ahead of her.
two_shot push_in: Devayani pleads with a hopeful, loving face, hands reaching; Kacha stands with his back half turned, not looking at her.
close pull_out: Kacha's face, turned away from her, speaks coldly with a hard look.
ots dolly_left: Kacha in the right foreground looks off to the right; behind him on the left Devayani stares at him, hurt.
close push_in: Devayani's eyes go wide with realisation as the word Mritasanjivani burns above her.
close pull_out: Kacha's cold face in close-up on the left while, behind him, the black shadow of his father Brihaspati looms with an ember outline.
close push_in: Devayani touches a smear of dark-red blood on her cheek and stares at her stained fingertips in horror.
medium dolly_right: Devayani points at Kacha with fury and grief, tears on her face.
wide pull_out: Devayani accuses Kacha across her father's bloody body lying between them; Kacha stands unmoved.
low_angle tilt_up: Kacha opens his hands to the starry night sky, calm, as if the universe agrees with him.
two_shot dolly_left: Kacha shrugs with open hands, cold and calm; Devayani listens with growing pain.
wide pan_left: Kacha points at the guru's body lying in blood; Devayani's eyes follow his finger to her father.
close push_in: Devayani's face in close-up, shock collapsing into grief, tears running.
wide pull_out: Devayani stands in the left foreground watching small Kacha walk away into the dark on the right.
wide dolly_right: Devayani kneels by her father's bloody body on the left while, far on the right, Kacha walks away.
close push_in: Devayani's crying face in close-up; on "Then" her eyes harden into fury.
low_angle tilt_up: Devayani rises and points at Kacha, a red ring of curse-light blazing around her hand.
close dolly_left: Devayani's furious face, red-eyed, speaking the curse while the red curse ring burns behind her.
medium push_in: Kacha, walking away, turns round to face her with a cold look.
low_angle tilt_up: Kacha raises the glowing mantra leaf high with a cold smile, talking.
medium dolly_right: Kacha points back at Devayani, a violet curse ring flaring around his hand.
wide crane_up: Devayani sinks to her knees alone in the dark yard, a faint violet curse light around her, crying.
medium pan_right: Kacha walks away into the dark holding the glowing mantra leaf, a cold smile on his face.
wide pull_out: Devayani kneels alone beside her father's body in the dark yard, head bowed.
two_shot push_in: Kacha's cold face on the left and Devayani's grieving face on the right; the words Hero or thief? appear between them.
wide crane_up: The dark ashram from above: Kacha a small figure walking off with the glowing leaf, Devayani kneeling by her father.
